abstract: OBJECTIVE: The purpose of this study was to evaluate the usefulness of MR imaging in the diagnosis and assessment of fetal sacrococcygeal teratoma and to determine if MR imaging provides information not seen on obstetric sonography. SUBJECTS AND METHODS: Twelve pregnant women were referred for fetal MR imaging of sacrococcygeal teratoma seen at obstetric sonography. The presence, size, content extension, and compressive effects of each mass were determined and correlated with the sonographic findings and with postnatal studies, including surgery and pathology. The extent of each sacrococcygeal teratoma was classified according to the American Association of the Pediatrics Surgery Section (types I-IV). RESULTS: There is a complete agreement of sonographic and MR imaging measurements. The sacrococcygeal teratomas appeared cystic with few septa in three fetuses, markedly septated or even microcystic in eight, and completely solid in one. The sonographic description of the content corresponded well to MR imaging findings in 10 of 12 fetuses. An agreement on the extent of each mass was observed in nine patients, whereas there is a disagreement in three, including in one fetus with an extension of the tumor within the spinal canal recognized only at MR imaging. The MR imaging findings were confirmed by postnatal studies in 10 patients. CONCLUSION: Sacrococcygeal teratomas had characteristic MR imaging appearances that allowed a complete assessment in most fetuses. Because of MR imaging, the prenatal evaluation was changed in some patients and affected counseling of the parents and treatment. MR imaging is a valuable adjunct to obstetric sonography for the prenatal evaluation of sacrococcygeal teratoma.
abstract_ja:
目的：胎児仙尾部奇形腫の出生前診断と評価における磁気共鳴画像法（MRI）の有用性を評価し、MRIが産科超音波検査では得られない情報を提供するかどうかを検討した。
対象と方法：産科超音波検査で仙尾部奇形腫が認められ、胎児MRIのために紹介された妊婦12例を対象とした。各腫瘤の有無、大きさ、内容の広がり、圧迫効果を求め、超音波所見および出生後の検査（手術および病理組織学的検査を含む）と対比した。仙尾部奇形腫の範囲は米国小児外科学会の分類（I～IV型）に従って分類した。
結果：超音波とMRIの計測値は完全に一致した。腫瘤は3例で嚢胞性で隔壁は少なく、8例では隔壁が多数あるいは微小嚢胞性、1例では完全充実性であった。内容の超音波所見は12例中10例でMRI所見と良く一致した。腫瘍の範囲は9例で一致したが、3例では不一致であり、そのうち1例では脊柱管内への腫瘍の進展がMRIでのみ認められた。MRI所見は10例で出生後の検査により確認された。
結論：仙尾部奇形腫は特徴的なMRI所見を示し、ほとんどの胎児で完全な評価が可能であった。MRIにより一部の症例では出生前評価が変更され、両親へのカウンセリングや治療にも影響した。MRIは胎児仙尾部奇形腫の出生前評価において産科超音波検査の有用な補助手段である。
